recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not restore `(type = 'history') or ...` for current builds; any future relaxation for resource-bearing history entries should be handled through a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-18284 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request raised and applied for STU3. It reported that bdl-7 failed history Bundles with multiple delete entries because those entries have no entry.resource and no resource.meta.versionId, and requested FHIRPath correction to reflect Bundle uniqueness text.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in dc4a4436ac41450dcf83c005b99929aa1a2db1f8 by changing the then-authoritative Bundle spreadsheet bdl-7 text to add "except in history bundles" and the FHIRPath to start with `(type = 'history') or ...`. Current source has since moved the authoritative invariant to source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml.
additional_context: Bundle is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-31986 clarified that the history exception was really about entries without resource bodies, such as history deletes, and directed bdl-7 to filter to entries where resource is present and compare fullUrl plus meta.versionId with a delimiter. Later Published issue FHIR-39476 added the absent-versionId fallback. The Bundle narrative still says a given resource version SHALL appear only once, while multiple versions may appear especially in history Bundles.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current bdl-7 filters to entries with both fullUrl and resource, then compares fullUrl plus meta.versionId with an empty-version fallback, so history delete entries no longer fail the invariant. Reintroducing a whole-history exemption would regress the later FHIR-31986/FHIR-39476 behavior.

related_jiras.note: Later Published FHIR-I decision narrowed the broad history exception to entries where resource is present and added a fullUrl/version delimiter; current source follows that refinement.
Later Published FHIR-I decision added the iif(..., '') fallback for absent meta.versionId; current source preserves that correction.

evidence_items.summary: Current bdl-7 applies only to entries with both fullUrl and resource, then compares fullUrl, a delimiter, and meta.versionId with an empty-version fallback.

evidence_items.summary: Bundle narrative permits multiple versions of a resource in a Bundle but says a given version SHALL appear only once.
evidence_items.learned: The current narrowed bdl-7 behavior is consistent with the narrative and should not become a blanket history exemption.
